about: Conversion constants between ROUNDS units and Cuphead units. Cuphead player is 50x105 units; Peashooter does 4 damage every 0.11 s (36 dps). A fresh ROUNDS gun (55 dmg, 0.3 s, 3 ammo, 1.5 s reload) is ~79 ROUNDS dps; damageScale puts it at ~75% of the Peashooter so cards matter.

ROUNDS guns are black: in ROUNDS the gun's sprites stay off and the gun shows as its soft shadow (SFPolygon) on the dark screen. Our frame has no shadow pass, so the gun sprites are drawn in this grey (arena players after ROUNDS colours a gun, and the world-map puppet)

The most cards a deck holds (loss picks and shop packs stop at it); 0 is no cap, ROUNDS's way. A deck only grows while a level keeps beating you and is wiped when you win it, so a cap is a safety valve, not the balance

ROUNDS draws its card bar for its own dark screen (a 21% fill, a 70% border). Over Cuphead's bright levels the UI frame's coverage is raised to 1-(1-a)^k so the bar reads as solid as the players; 1 leaves it as ROUNDS draws it
